title: Overview and Architecture
description: Start with the main README.md to understand the purpose of the project, including how it converts Markdown to LaTeX, compiles it to PDF, and runs using Docker.

title: Frontend App Interface
description: The React entry point is main.jsx, which mounts the main App.jsx. App.jsx handles the user workspace, Markdown editor, compilation trigger, and PDF viewer.

title: Backend Server Entry Point
description: backend/src/server.js hosts the Express server. It exposes endpoints for document compiling, user authentication, and document history management.

title: Core MD to LaTeX Compiler
description: mdToLatex.js contains the regex patterns and rules that parse markdown headers, bold, italics, links, and code blocks, translating them into valid LaTeX tags.

title: Database Schema and Persistence
description: Mongoose schemas are used to structure MongoDB records for User accounts (credentials/hash) and Document history (markdown, generated latex, and compilation logs).

title: Local Container Orchestration
description: docker-compose.yml coordinates backend, frontend, and mongodb containers, creating a complete environment including networks, volumes, and ports.
